name: 9/11 Authorized Bus Parking Permit
description:
This dataset contains records of authorized bus parking permits issued in connection with 9/11, with about 3,900 sampled rows and 22 columns. Each row represents a permit and includes the permit year, permit and reservation numbers, valid date, bus arrival time, day of week, number of buses, permit type and quantity, and vehicle type. It also captures company details such as company name, bus company name, city, state, and ZIP code, along with issue date, return quantity, return date, and condition or restriction notes.

The data could be used to analyze bus parking demand and scheduling around 9/11 events, examine permit issuance and return patterns by company or location, study arrival times and weekday trends, or support transportation planning and historical research on event-related bus operations.
